content.text: How often should I oil my chain?
Every 300 to 500 kilometres, and after any ride in the rain. Wipe off the extra oil afterwards so it does not collect grit.

content.text: My brakes squeal when I stop. Is that dangerous?
Squealing usually means dirty or worn pads. If the bike takes longer to stop or the lever feels soft, bring it in today.
